changelog:
- Initial release of the ClaWHub skill for EnsembleData Social Media Scraping API.
- Supports real-time data scraping across 8 platforms: TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Reddit, Twitter, Twitch, Snapchat, and Threads.
- Includes details on authentication, error codes, platform endpoints, and metered pricing.
- Provides usage and account monitoring endpoints at no charge.
- Offers SDK quick start guides for Python (sync/async) and Node.js.
- Outlines cursor-based pagination and platform compliance information.
summary: Access real-time public social media data from TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Reddit, Twitter, Twitch, Snapchat, and Threads via EnsembleData's REST API.
